description: Compare two non-prescription medicines with the same active substance, like the "X czy Y" pages on apteka.online: indications from each SmPC (section 4.1), forms and strengths they share or not, and their offers in the shop. Only curated pairs: polocard czy acard, altaziaja czy altacet, zoxin-med czy nizoral, apselan czy sudafed, traumon czy difortan, voltaren-sport czy voltaren-max, etodal czy traumon, recigar czy tabex, otrivin czy xylogel, no-spa czy no-spa-max, hederasal czy prospan, cyclodynon czy castagnus, acatar-zatoki czy ibuprom-zatoki, maxiseptic czy octenisept, upsarin-c czy aspirin-c, essentiale-max czy essentiale-forte, biotebal czy biotynox. Quote the indications, do not recommend one over the other. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice. Medicine data comes from the Polish register of medicinal products (RPL) and the Ministry of Health refund announcement: prescription medicines are shown for information only and are not sold online, and refund prices are official maximum prices, not apteka.online prices.
